There might be some details there that will help clarify the issue with the endpoint resolver. Let's dig deeper!

62: 						`"AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT" is set to %q and "AWS_METADATA_URL" is set to %q. Ignoring "AWS_METADATA_URL".`,
63: 						ec2MetadataServiceEndpoint,
64: 						metadataUrl,
65: 					)
66: 				}
67: 			} else {
68: 				logger.Warn(baseCtx, fmt.Sprintf(`Setting "AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT" to %q.`, metadataUrl))
69: 				os.Setenv("AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT", metadataUrl)
70: 			}
71: 			diags = diags.AddWarning(
72: 				"Deprecated Environment Variable",
73: 				warningMsg,
74: 			)
75: 		}
76: 	}
77: 
78: 	c.ValidateProxySettings(&diags)
79: 	if diags.HasError() {
80: 		return ctx, aws.Config{}, diags
81: 	}
82: 
83: 	logger.Debug(baseCtx, "Resolving credentials provider")
84: 	credentialsProvider, initialSource, d := getCredentialsProvider(baseCtx, c)
85: 	if d.HasError() {
86: 		return ctx, aws.Config{}, diags.Append(d...)
87: 	}
88: 	creds, err := credentialsProvider.Retrieve(baseCtx)
89: 	if err != nil {
90: 		return ctx, aws.Config{}, diags.AddSimpleError(fmt.Errorf("retrieving credentials: %w", err))
91: 	}
92: 	logger.Info(baseCtx, "Retrieved credentials", map[string]any{
93: 		"tf_aws.credentials_source": creds.Source,
94: 	})
95: 
96: 	loadOptions, err := commonLoadOptions(baseCtx, c)
97: 	if err != nil {
98: 		return ctx, aws.Config{}, diags.AddSimpleError(err)
99: 	}
100: 
101: 	if c.Profile != "" {
102: 		loadOptions = append(
103: 			loadOptions,
104: 			config.WithSharedConfigProfile(c.Profile),
105: 		)
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	// The providers set `MaxRetries` to a very large value.
109: 	// Add retries here so that authentication has a reasonable number of retries
110: 	if c.MaxRetries != 0 {
111: 		loadOptions = append(
112: 			loadOptions,
113: 			config.WithRetryMaxAttempts(c.MaxRetries),
114: 		)
115: 	}
116: 
117: 	loadOptions = append(
118: 		loadOptions,
119: 		config.WithCredentialsProvider(credentialsProvider),
120: 	)
121: 
122: 	if initialSource == ec2rolecreds.ProviderName {
123: 		loadOptions = append(
124: 			loadOptions,
125: 			config.WithEC2IMDSRegion(),
126: 		)
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	logger.Debug(baseCtx, "Loading configuration")
130: 	awsConfig, err := config.LoadDefaultConfig(baseCtx, loadOptions...)
131: 	if err != nil {
132: 		return ctx, aws.Config{}, diags.AddSimpleError(fmt.Errorf("loading configuration: %w", err))
133: 	}
134: 
135: 	resolveRetryer(baseCtx, &awsConfig)
136: 
137: 	if !c.SkipCredsValidation {
138: 		if _, _, err := getAccountIDAndPartitionFromSTSGetCallerIdentity(baseCtx, stsClient(baseCtx, awsConfig, c)); err != nil {
139: 			return ctx, awsConfig, diags.AddSimpleError(fmt.Errorf("validating provider credentials: %w", err))
140: 		}
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	return ctx, awsConfig, diags

146: // Adapted from the per-service-client `resolveRetryer()` functions in the AWS SDK for Go v2
147: // e.g. https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/blob/main/service/accessanalyzer/api_client.go
148: func resolveRetryer(ctx context.Context, awsConfig *aws.Config) {
149: 	retryMode := awsConfig.RetryMode
150: 	if len(retryMode) == 0 {
151: 		defaultsMode := resolveDefaultsMode(ctx, awsConfig)
152: 		modeConfig, err := defaults.GetModeConfiguration(defaultsMode)
153: 		if err == nil {
154: 			retryMode = modeConfig.RetryMode
155: 		}
156: 	}
157: 	if len(retryMode) == 0 {
158: 		retryMode = aws.RetryModeStandard
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	var standardOptions []func(*retry.StandardOptions)
162: 	if v, found, _ := awsconfig.GetRetryMaxAttempts(ctx, awsConfig.ConfigSources); found && v != 0 {
163: 		standardOptions = append(standardOptions, func(so *retry.StandardOptions) {
164: 			so.MaxAttempts = v
165: 		})
166: 	}
167: 
168: 	var retryer aws.RetryerV2
169: 	switch retryMode {
170: 	case aws.RetryModeAdaptive:
171: 		var adaptiveOptions []func(*retry.AdaptiveModeOptions)
172: 		if len(standardOptions) != 0 {
173: 			adaptiveOptions = append(adaptiveOptions, func(ao *retry.AdaptiveModeOptions) {
174: 				ao.StandardOptions = append(ao.StandardOptions, standardOptions...)
175: 			})
176: 		}
177: 		retryer = retry.NewAdaptiveMode(adaptiveOptions...)
178: 
179: 	default:
180: 		retryer = retry.NewStandard(standardOptions...)
181: 	}
182: 
183: 	awsConfig.Retryer = func() aws.Retryer {
184: 		return &networkErrorShortcutter{
185: 			RetryerV2: retryer,
186: 		}
187: 	}
188: }
189: 
190: // Adapted from the per-service-client `setResolvedDefaultsMode()` functions in the AWS SDK for Go v2
191: // e.g. https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/blob/main/service/accessanalyzer/api_client.go
192: func resolveDefaultsMode(_ context.Context, awsConfig *aws.Config) aws.DefaultsMode {
193: 	var mode aws.DefaultsMode
194: 	mode.SetFromString(string(awsConfig.DefaultsMode))
195: 
196: 	if mode == aws.DefaultsModeAuto {
197: 		mode = defaults.ResolveDefaultsModeAuto(awsConfig.Region, awsConfig.RuntimeEnvironment)
198: 	}
199: 
200: 	return mode
201: }

203: // networkErrorShortcutter is used to enable networking error shortcutting
204: type networkErrorShortcutter struct {
205: 	aws.RetryerV2
206: }
207: 
208: // We're misusing RetryDelay here, since this is the only function that takes the attempt count
209: func (r *networkErrorShortcutter) RetryDelay(attempt int, err error) (time.Duration, error) {
210: 	if attempt >= constants.MaxNetworkRetryCount {
211: 		var netOpErr *net.OpError
212: 		if errors.As(err, &netOpErr) {
213: 			// It's disappointing that we have to do string matching here, rather than being able to using `errors.Is()` or even strings exported by the Go `net` package
214: 			if strings.Contains(netOpErr.Error(), "no such host") || strings.Contains(netOpErr.Error(), "connection refused") {
215: 				// TODO: figure out how to get correct logger here
216: 				log.Printf("[WARN] Disabling retries after next request due to networking error: %s", err)
217: 				return 0, &retry.MaxAttemptsError{
218: 					Attempt: attempt,
219: 					Err:     err,
220: 				}
221: 			}
222: 		}
223: 	}
224: 
225: 	return r.RetryerV2.RetryDelay(attempt, err)
226: }

228: func GetAwsAccountIDAndPartition(ctx context.Context, awsConfig aws.Config, c *Config) (string, string, diag.Diagnostics) {
229: 	var diags diag.Diagnostics
230: 
231: 	var logger logging.Logger = logging.NullLogger{}
232: 	if c.Logger != nil {
233: 		logger = c.Logger
234: 	}
235: 	ctx = configCommonLogging(ctx)
236: 	ctx, logger = logger.SubLogger(ctx, loggerName)
237: 	ctx = logging.RegisterLogger(ctx, logger)

239: 	if !c.SkipCredsValidation {
240: 		stsClient := stsClient(ctx, awsConfig, c)
241: 		accountID, partition, err := getAccountIDAndPartitionFromSTSGetCallerIdentity(ctx, stsClient)
242: 		if err != nil {
243: 			return "", "", diags.AddSimpleError(fmt.Errorf("validating provider credentials: %w", err))
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		return accountID, partition, nil
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if !c.SkipRequestingAccountId {
250: 		credentialsProviderName := ""
251: 		if credentialsValue, err := awsConfig.Credentials.Retrieve(context.Background()); err == nil {
252: 			credentialsProviderName = credentialsValue.Source
253: 		}
254: 
255: 		iamClient := iamClient(ctx, awsConfig, c)
256: 		stsClient := stsClient(ctx, awsConfig, c)

259: 		if err == nil {

263: 		return "", "", diags.AddSimpleError(fmt.Errorf(

266: 				"Errors: %w", err))
267: 	}

269: 	return "", endpoints.PartitionForRegion(awsConfig.Region), nil

272: func commonLoadOptions(ctx context.Context, c *Config) ([]func(*config.LoadOptions) error, error) {
273: 	logger := logging.RetrieveLogger(ctx)
274: 
275: 	var err error
276: 	var httpClient config.HTTPClient
277: 
278: 	if v := c.HTTPClient; v == nil {
279: 		logger.Trace(ctx, "Building default HTTP client")
280: 		httpClient, err = defaultHttpClient(c)
281: 		if err != nil {
282: 			return nil, err
283: 		}
284: 	} else {
285: 		logger.Debug(ctx, "Setting HTTP client", map[string]any{
286: 			"tf_aws.http_client.source": configSourceProviderConfig,
287: 		})
288: 		httpClient = v
289: 	}
290: 
291: 	apiOptions := make([]func(*middleware.Stack) error, 0)
292: 	if c.APNInfo != nil {
293: 		apiOptions = append(apiOptions, func(stack *middleware.Stack) error {
294: 			// Because the default User-Agent middleware prepends itself to the contents of the User-Agent header,
295: 			// we have to run after it and also prepend our custom User-Agent
296: 			return stack.Build.Add(apnUserAgentMiddleware(*c.APNInfo), middleware.After)
297: 		})
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	if len(c.UserAgent) > 0 {
301: 		apiOptions = append(apiOptions, withUserAgentAppender(c.UserAgent))
302: 	}
303: 
304: 	apiOptions = append(apiOptions, func(stack *middleware.Stack) error {
305: 		return stack.Build.Add(userAgentFromContextMiddleware(), middleware.After)
306: 	})
307: 
308: 	if v := os.Getenv(constants.AppendUserAgentEnvVar); v != "" {
309: 		logger.Debug(ctx, "Adding User-Agent info", map[string]any{
310: 			"source": fmt.Sprintf("envvar(%q)", constants.AppendUserAgentEnvVar),
311: 			"value":  v,
312: 		})
313: 		apiOptions = append(apiOptions, awsmiddleware.AddUserAgentKey(v))
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if !c.SuppressDebugLog {
317: 		apiOptions = append(apiOptions,
318: 			func(stack *middleware.Stack) error {
319: 				return stack.Initialize.Add(&logAttributeExtractor{}, middleware.After)
320: 			},
321: 			func(stack *middleware.Stack) error {
322: 				return stack.Deserialize.Add(&requestResponseLogger{}, middleware.After)
323: 			},
324: 		)
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	loadOptions := []func(*config.LoadOptions) error{
328: 		config.WithRegion(c.Region),
329: 		config.WithHTTPClient(httpClient),
330: 		config.WithAPIOptions(apiOptions),
331: 		config.WithEC2IMDSClientEnableState(c.EC2MetadataServiceEnableState),
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	if !c.SuppressDebugLog {
335: 		loadOptions = append(
336: 			loadOptions,
337: 			config.WithClientLogMode(aws.LogDeprecatedUsage|aws.LogRetries),
338: 			config.WithLogger(debugLogger{}),
339: 		)
340: 	}
341: 
342: 	sharedCredentialsFiles, err := c.ResolveSharedCredentialsFiles()
343: 	if err != nil {
344: 		return nil, err
345: 	}
346: 	if len(sharedCredentialsFiles) > 0 {
347: 		loadOptions = append(
348: 			loadOptions,
349: 			config.WithSharedCredentialsFiles(sharedCredentialsFiles),
350: 		)
351: 	}
352: 
353: 	sharedConfigFiles, err := c.ResolveSharedConfigFiles()
354: 	if err != nil {
355: 		return nil, err
356: 	}
357: 	if len(sharedConfigFiles) > 0 {
358: 		loadOptions = append(
359: 			loadOptions,
360: 			config.WithSharedConfigFiles(sharedConfigFiles),
361: 		)
362: 	}
363: 
364: 	if c.CustomCABundle != "" {
365: 		reader, err := c.CustomCABundleReader()
366: 		if err != nil {
367: 			return nil, err
368: 		}
369: 		loadOptions = append(loadOptions,
370: 			config.WithCustomCABundle(reader),
371: 		)
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	if c.EC2MetadataServiceEndpoint != "" {
375: 		loadOptions = append(loadOptions,
376: 			config.WithEC2IMDSEndpoint(c.EC2MetadataServiceEndpoint),
377: 		)
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	if c.RetryMode != "" {
381: 		loadOptions = append(loadOptions,
382: 			config.WithRetryMode(c.RetryMode),
383: 		)
384: 	}
385: 
386: 	if c.EC2MetadataServiceEndpointMode != "" {
387: 		var endpointMode imds.EndpointModeState
388: 		err := endpointMode.SetFromString(c.EC2MetadataServiceEndpointMode)
389: 		if err != nil {
390: 			return nil, err
391: 		}
392: 		loadOptions = append(loadOptions,
393: 			config.WithEC2IMDSEndpointMode(endpointMode),
394: 		)
395: 	}
396: 
397: 	// This should not be needed, but https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/issues/1398

399: 		os.Setenv("AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED", "false")

401: 		os.Setenv("AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED", "true")
